description: This file defines classes that extend grain state with versioning metadata for Orleans event sourcing. It includes the classes LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag and LogStateWithMetaData, which manage log data and associated metadata for grains with log-view consistency.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag
classes.description: A sealed class that extends grain state with versioning metadata and an ETag, implementing IGrainState for log state with metadata and ETag.

classes.name: LogStateWithMetaData
classes.description: A sealed class that holds log entries and write vector metadata, providing methods for versioning and concurrency control in log-based grains.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LogStateWithMetaDataAndETag object, including version, flags, ETag, and log data.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit for a given replica from the WriteVector, indicating if that replica has appended data.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Flips the bit for a given replica in the WriteVector, used for concurrency control and retry logic.
